turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Hi! Here's your cake. Is everything okay?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Sorry, I think there's a problem. I ordered a chocolate cake, and this one is vanilla. Also, the name is wrong. It says Nona, not Mona.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Oh no, I'm really sorry. I can change the name on this one right now. It only takes five minutes.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thanks, but she really wants chocolate. It's her favourite. Do you have a chocolate cake I could take today?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: We have a chocolate cake ready in the fridge, but there's no writing on it yet. Writing the name would take about fifteen minutes.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: The party starts in fifty minutes, and it takes thirty minutes to get there. So fifteen minutes is okay. Is it the same size?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Yes, same size and same price, so there's nothing extra to pay.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Great, I'll take the chocolate cake, please. Can you check the spelling this time? M-O-N-A.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Of course. Chocolate cake, "Happy Birthday, Mona", ready in fifteen minutes.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Perfect, thank you. I'll wait here.
